translations.web: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
translations.bsb: “Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
translations.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
